summary: Configured node1 to run inventory maintenance daily at 02:15 and append output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Configuration and output persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Repaired the malformed maintenance script and set it executable.
Created /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance with the required schedule and log redirection.
Verified crond is active and enabled and that the command appends expected output.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity, scheduler recovery, configuration persistence, and retained log data.

evidence.requirement: Run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and retain output in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: Shows the exact 02:15 cron entry, valid ownership and modes, active/enabled crond, retained log output, and successful post-restart execution.
Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID after recovery, and direct post-restart proof of the service, schedule, script, and log.
